characters.name: Ralph Kramden
characters.description: Acrofatic: Yep. Just watch his cartwheels. Beware the Nice Ones: Despite his temper, Ralph is a nice, albeit obnoxious guy. But put him or his family in danger and he will knock you out.In "Trapped," Ralph, Alice, and Norton are held hostage by bank robbers. When one of the robbers takes Ralph into the bedroom to beat him, Ralph effortlessly  beats the robber senseless offscreen and steals his gun.In "Harvey" Ralph angers a large man in a pool hall who challenges him to a fight, so Norton gets one of his friends to agree to take a fall so that Ralph looks tough. Ralph knocks out a rude man in the pool hall with one punch thinking it was Norton's friend, only to be told by Norton that his friend got sick and couldn't come. Bear in mind, Ralph wasn't even trying to knock the man out since he thought he was in on the scam, and he still dropped him in one punch. Hair-Trigger Temper: Ralph can go from calm to extremely angry with minimal provocation and usually deals with it by threatening and insulting others.

characters.name: Alice Kramden
characters.description: Closer to Earth: Originally, Pert Kelton's Alice was supposed to be a shrew, and just as bad as Ralph. When Audrey Meadows replaced Kelton (after Kelton got blacklisted), the character was retooled to become the cooler-headed, sarcastic foil to her husband she's forever remembered as. Deadpan Snarker: She always responds to Ralph's bluster with biting, deadpan wit.

characters.name: Ed Norton
characters.description: Catchphrase: (Whenever Ralph yells at him) Gee, what a grouch! Cloudcuckoolander: Ed always has his head in the clouds but often...he's right about something. Last-Name Basis: Ralph calls Ed Norton "Norton". For that matter, it seems likeeveryonecalls him 'Norton' much more than they do 'Ed'... including Trixie, who only calls him "My Ed" when she's worried about him like when he's sleepwalking.

characters.name: Trixie Norton
characters.description: Satellite Character: She's Ed's wife and Alice's best friend. There's not much else to her than that, and much of her role is to be someone other than Ralph for Ed and Alice to talk to.
